senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) man, pr. n. m. Adam, frequ. א׳ הראשון (abbr. אה״ר).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:8">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ספרו של</he>, <he>ספרא דאה״ר אה״ר</he> the (allegorical) book of Adam containing all generations and their leaders from beginning to resurrection, i.e. destinies of humanity.
